When Everything Depends On You
Tarbiyyah Bukan Terbiar (TBT): The Good Husband Series

Marriage comes with responsibilities that extend beyond providing and protecting. For many men, the expectations of being a husband can carry pressures that are often left unspoken. From financial responsibilities and emotional strength to leadership, decision-making and fulfilling the amanah entrusted to them.

In this session of TBT: The Good Husband Series, we take a closer look at the realities faced by married men and explore what it means to carry these responsibilities with wisdom, ihsan and faith.

Join us for a morning of meaningful conversations through a main talk and breakout discussions, as we reflect on the pressures, responsibilities and amanah of married men.

📅 Saturday, 3 October 2026 ⏰ 1.30pm – 4pm 📍 Al-Falah Mosque 🎟️ Free course
